text:
Maya: @eng-platform quick question — PR #5241 touches runtime init and a bunch of docs. CODEOWNERS points to `eng-runtime/*` and `docs/*` but no owner listed for `resources/` so who can approve the infra bits? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5241 :eyes:

Alex: if it's only a tiny infra tweak, eng-infra usually ok, but CODEOWNERS is unclear. pinging @sam

Sam: I can take a look if it's small. Can you paste the diff for the infra part? Also what's the risk re: deploys?

Maya: infra part is this change:
```
- resources/gpu_pool.tf: add optional tag for dedup
+ resources/gpu_pool.tf: add `project` tag (nullable)
```
No rollout config changes, just tag. No deploy required.

Sam: ok that's safe. I'm not listed in CODEOWNERS for `resources/` though. Is there an approved proxy rule when owners missing?

Kris: We have an ownerless fallback policy — eng-platform leads can proxy-approve for small infra tweaks while oncall if owner is missing. I'm oncall today, I can approve if Sam signs off on technical. :+1:

Sam: Reviewed the snippet, no infra risk. :thumbsup: Maya, can you add a small PR description note and I'll ack?

Maya: done — added `no-deploy: true` and test notes.

Kris: Ack from me, merging now. Please follow up with a CODEOWNERS PR to add eng-infra to `resources/*` so we don't hit this again.

Maya: will file CODEOWNERS update, thanks both :tada:

oncall-bot: Deploy queued for next window (ops-scheduler) — no manual action required.
